method: Replay published fit, contrast and suppression through EditingSession, with no weight writes or editor requests.
fresh_design: Researcher-authored transfer probes fixed before replay. Six new reviews, two per sentiment, each with two instructions. Exact text checked against the public logs and input packets of all four arms. These are auxiliary probes outside official IWIBench scoring.

paged.control_feature_selection: Fixed from the source trace as the next highest activation other than the selected feature on the first recorded probe.

all_feature_comparison.comparison: Scale every feature to zero at the same final prefix token. Features retain their naturally observed activation and decoder direction. Magnitudes are not normalized.

eager.control_feature_selection: Fixed from the source trace as the next highest activation other than the selected feature on the first recorded probe.

recorded_suppressions_reproduced.feedback: This feature was zero at every inspected position. Choose a nonzero feature from the baseline observations and repeat on a case to improve and a case to preserve.
